calculate_l1_min_c: calculate the minimum C bound for l1 penalized classifiers using training data and labels
compute_l1_min_c_squared_hinge: compute the minimum C bound for l1 penalized SVM with squared hinge loss
compute_l1_min_c_log_loss: compute the minimum C bound for logistic regression models with log loss
test_l1_min_c: test the l1_min_c function with sample classification data and verify minimum C output
summarize_l1_min_c: summarize the l1_min_c function that returns the lowest C bound for l1 penalized models
